documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015- ESG Rating

analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial performance with standalone revenue of INR247.03 crores and consolidated revenue of INR269.23 crores, registering growth on a year-on-year basis. Management highlighted that export business growth contributed to overall profitability, while domestic footwear volumes were impacted by rising raw material prices. The company has ordered an additional production line in its current premises to expand capacity by 5 lakh meters by the end of the financial year and continues to evaluate potential international and domestic expansion locations. Management expects a top-line growth of 10% to 15% over the next three years, driven primarily by strong export market opportunities. Mayur Uniquoters Limited reported Q4 and FY26 financial results, with standalone revenue reaching INR 260.55 crores and consolidated revenue at INR 273.35 crores for the quarter.

guidance.claim: The company expects top-line growth between 10% to 15% over the next 3 years.
guidance.quote: So, we have already said that you can expect a top line growth of between 10% to 12% for the next 3 years. This is what we can say currently right now.

guidance.claim: The company expects domestic growth between 8%-10% and export growth between 15%-20% over the next 2-3 years.
guidance.quote: So, we have said in the last phone call also, our expectation from domestic growth is between 8%-10%. And our expectation from export growth is from 15%-20%.

guidance.claim: The company has kept a potential outlook for a 15% growth in the coming year.
guidance.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

guidance.claim: Value is expected to grow by 15% for the next 2 years while margins remain at a similar level.
guidance.quote: value 15% for next 2 years and margin more or less similar level.

demand_outlook.claim: Automotive sector demand is expected to drive more growth in both domestic and international markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Obviously, we are focusing more on the automotive sector. So, we see more growth coming from the automotive side, whether it's in the domestic market or in the international market.

demand_outlook.claim: The polyurethane (PU) business remains muted with volumes and sales not increasing significantly.
demand_outlook.quote: So, PU, still the business is muted right now. We have not been able to succeed too much in terms of the volume in PU and increasing in sales.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the Marine business is growing very fast and Europe is a great market for it.
demand_outlook.quote: So our Marine business is also growing very fast and Europe is also a great market for it.

capex_expansion.claim: The company ordered a new line for expansion in its current premises with production expected to start towards the end of February or March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: The new expansion line will provide an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.
capex_expansion.quote: So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is considering various locations such as Mexico, the U.S., or other NAFTA areas for an international plant.
capex_expansion.quote: So it could be in Mexico, it could be in U.S., it could be in some other NAFTA areas.

capex_expansion.claim: The new coating line is expected to be operational by the end of the calendar year.
capex_expansion.quote: We have already ordered for an existing location. So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done. Maybe 1 month plus or minus.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that sustainable margins are expected to be around 25% plus 1% or 2%.
margins_costs.quote: No. This margin is -- actually, we told you earlier also in our previous con call that margin -- sustainable margin will be 25 plus 1% or 2%.

margins_costs.claim: Shipment costs for exports increased significantly during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: And secondly, because of this war, the shipments cost have also increased. It's 4x higher, the shipment cost was increased.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices for paste PVC increased significantly, but availability issues have been resolved.
margins_costs.quote: So, obviously, it's a petroleum by-product. So, the prices have gone up and the prices have gone up significantly. So, there was a challenge initially in the month of March where people were expecting that there could be an issue regarding the availability of the raw material. But I think those issues are resolved now. And prices have also softened a little bit from the highs of March.

margins_costs.claim: Freight costs went down during the quarter due to the war situation, and repair and maintenance costs were controlled.
margins_costs.quote: Our freight cost has gone down in this quarter because of this war situation and all and second one our maintenance cost repair and maintenance cost and consumables were also controlled and because of these two reasons our other income reduced

margins_costs.claim: Operating efficiency and productivity (OE) improved in the last quarter and contributed to margin improvement.
margins_costs.quote: So, our productivity where we measure the OE has also improved in the last quarter compared to our previous year and that has also contributed to the improvement in margins.

margins_costs.claim: Plasticizer and yarn prices have started going up.
margins_costs.quote: In fact, plasticizers prices have started going up. Yarn prices have started going up.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization is running between 75% and 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed PVC capacity is between 3.5 million to 3.7 million meters depending on the product mix.
orders_capacity.quote: So, our PVC capacity is between 3.5 million to 3.7 million meters depending on the product mix a lot, because some products have a faster line speed, some product has a slower line speed.

orders_capacity.claim: The new coating line capacity is estimated to add an average of 5 lakh meters monthly.
orders_capacity.quote: Generally average is 5 lakh meter monthly. It is rough calculation, it could be 4 and 6 too, but average will be that.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume for the quarter has been 76.3 lakh meters, including PU which was 2.56 lakh meters.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volume has been 76.3 lakh meters, including PU, which has been 2.56 lakh meters for the quarter and value 6.17.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted market volatility due to factors like Trump tariffs, West Asia war, and raw material price fluctuations.
risks_headwinds.quote: But because of all this Trump tariff, the West Asia war or multiple things happening in the last few years, we have not taken a final call where -- which should be the ideal location to put our plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: Short-term impacts on raw material prices occur because it takes time to pass price increases on to customers.
risks_headwinds.quote: Short-term, yes, maybe a month or so. Because it takes some time to pass on the price increase to the customers. Definitely, it impacts a little bit in the short-term.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the European automotive industry is experiencing a story of degrowth.
risks_headwinds.quote: But if you see, European automotive industry is not growing as much rather than it's -- there is a story of degrowth over there.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects export sales growth and increased momentum to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this sales growth and increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The increased export momentum is expected to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to carry out regular plantation and large-scale tree planting in coming years under its CSR program.
management_commitments.quote: Under the Corporate Social Responsibility Program, we have contributed towards the regular plantations, approximate 45,000 plus plants we have already done, and have a plan to do it at large scale in coming years.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to maintain its margin levels around 25%-30% if growth momentum continues.
management_commitments.quote: So, we should look at somewhere around 25%-30% margin.

management_commitments.claim: Export momentum and top-line contribution are expected to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Once a decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the South plant to start.
management_commitments.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
